claims.assertion: Mari says most high-altitude contrails are ice formed as atmospheric water condenses around jet-exhaust hydrocarbons; they may persist and cloud skies.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says most are benign water crystals.

claims.assertion: Mari alleges dedicated aircraft spray cloud-seeding chemicals and biological agents, while most passenger jets do not spray.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says engine heat would destroy many agents in commercial-jet fuel.

claims.assertion: Mari claims nonhuman starships conduct most large-scale spraying and weather control from high altitudes.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She attributes the operations to the Federation and says the craft are difficult to detect.

review_flags: The source makes unverified allegations about chemical and biological spraying and nonhuman weather control.
